purpose: xg-compare: the frozen design (council C4), the category dictionary, the shot table it runs on and the expected power, written before any category-level outcome or gap was computed (xg-compare ticket 01)
provenance: Transcribed from .scratch/xg-compare/spec.md, Decisions -> C4, and council record C4 (.scratch/xg-detector/council.md). Ticket 02 refuses to run unless this file's SHA-256 is the one recorded in ticket 01. This file is not edited afterwards.

notation.z_X: method X's logit on the main scale
notation.gap: g = z_F - z_V (frame minus vendor) unless stated otherwise
notation.adjusted_effect: coefficient of the indicator in the OLS fit g ~ 1 + indicator + z_D
notation.references: beside every F - V effect, the same effects for D - V and P - V
notation.xg_points: every logit effect is also given in xG points at the category mean

scale.main: outcome-recalibrated: shared cross-fitted Platt recalibration as in the paper (xgpoc.vendor.ladder: 5 match-grouped folds, fold seed 0), refitted separately inside each population, each split half and each bootstrap draw; never called label-free

methods.F: frame: retrained G-combo at the anchor (frame_logit_0)
methods.A1: G-combo with detector inputs (results/xgd_test/predictions.csv, primary shots only)

populations.primary: main population: paired SoccerNet shots, non-penalty, with a scored frame (xgpoc.vendor.ladder.analysis_population on the confirmatory table)
populations.combined: robustness only: primary plus StatsBomb-only shots and recovered goals with frames, without the label exclusions and the pre-registered frame exclusion; it reuses the primary shots, so it is not a replication

bootstrap.draws_definition: xgpoc.vendor.draws.table_draws over the matches of the shot table (match-clustered, count-weighted)

p_values.two-sided: min(1, 2 * min(share of draws <= 0, share of draws >= 0))

floors.below_floor: a level below a floor is shown as descriptive, with its n

thresholds.meaning: a finding is called interesting only at or above its threshold

family.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 over the 14 items; Benjamini-Yekutieli as a sensitivity check
family.test: every item on its adjusted effect; directional items one-sided, the others two-sided

kinds.gap: coefficient of the level indicator in the OLS fit g ~ 1 + indicator + z_D over the shots where the category is defined; g = z_F - z_V on the main scale
kinds.log_loss: coefficient of the level indicator in the OLS fit (LL(F) - LL(V)) ~ 1 + indicator + z_D, with LL the per-shot log-loss of the main-scale probabilities
kinds.correlation_difference: Spearman(F, D) - Spearman(F, V) of the probabilities over the population
kinds.correlation_contrast: [Spearman(F, V) - Spearman(P, V)] of the probabilities among the level's shots minus the same among the reference shots; each group meets the category floor

outside_family.1: owner's statement (a): non-goal shots from outside the box (sb_outcome != Goal, outside_box = yes); on target = sb_outcome in (Saved, Saved to Post), off target = sb_outcome in (Off T, Post, Wayward); Blocked and Saved Off Target reported apart; F and F-400 side by side with the paper's H4 controls (vendor logit, StatsBomb body-part and shot-type indicators); a re-expression of the paper's H4, post-contact
outside_family.13: on target overall (on_target_sn): reported as the paper's known H4 result
outside_family.negative_control: half: first against second half, expected to stay inside the threshold

scan.scope: F - V only, every scan level of the dictionary (category role 'category'); descriptive, post-shot, sensitivity and negative-control categories are not scanned

split.rule: for each league-season in sorted order, its sorted matches are permuted by one default_rng(seed); the concatenated list is assigned alternately discovery, validation, discovery, ...

scan.candidate: |adjusted effect| >= 0.2 and two-sided p < 0.05 on the discovery half, and the floors met in both halves
scan.freeze: candidates, directions and estimands are written to a file and hashed before the validation half is touched
scan.validation: one-sided test in the discovered direction on the validation half, Holm at 0.05 across the candidates; pass = 'replicated exploratory'
scan.not_replicated: 'hypothesis-generating', appendix only, never in the summary
scan.descriptive_scans: F - D and F - P scans in an appendix, without tests

rules: F and F-400 always side by side; a gap that vanishes at -400 ms reads as the frame seeing the result after contact, not as a valuation
gaps and discrimination (where both goal classes exist) only; no calibration inside outcome-defined categories
SoccerNet on target includes blocked shots; StatsBomb Blocked appears mainly in the combined population

design.frames: no frame is looked at, by people or agents; the 5% largest F - V disagreements in each direction are listed by shot ID with their category profile and goal rate, for the owner
design.who_is_right: descriptive, per category and method: O - E, O/E, log-loss, delta LL against V, AUC where both goal classes meet the floor
design.agreement: descriptive except items 8 and 9: Spearman matrix of all methods, overall and per category, plus Pearson on logits; differences between dependent correlations are bootstrapped jointly
design.status: exploratory, post hoc on frozen predictions whose labels the xg-vendor confirmatory run already joined

readings: Category bins (distance, angle, goalkeeper depth and lateral offset, nearest opponent, keypoints, minute) were fixed in ticket 01 from football conventions and the label-free distributions, since the spec names these categories but not their bins.

Item 6a's '4 m' is the comparator's gk_depth >= 4 in StatsBomb units (yards), the units of the label-free median 2.1 and p75 3.4 quoted in C4. 'Goalkeeper distance from goal' is the gk_depth category; gk_dist_goal is not binned separately.

Key-pass type is four binary categories (cross, through ball, cut-back, none) because StatsBomb flags overlap (a cross can also be a cut-back); key-pass height is defined only for shots with a key pass.
A shot whose category value is missing (no goalkeeper in the freeze frame, no detector descriptor) is left out of both sides of that category's comparison.
The previous shot of a rebound is any StatsBomb Shot event (penalties included) of the same match, period and possession, by event index; the window is 0 to 5 s (0 to 3 s) inclusive.
Item 16's adjusted effect uses z_D as its control, like item 10 (C4 names the control for item 10 only).

Spearman correlations (items 8, 9 and the agreement matrix) are of the raw probabilities, as the spec's Analysis 1 says; they are label-free. Pearson correlations are of the main-scale logits; Pearson of the raw logits is the sensitivity check.
Item 9 is tested only when headers and foot shots each meet the category floor (50 shots, headers in 20 matches).
The rebound subtypes (after a save, after a block) are descriptive, as C4 says, so they are not scanned.

Item 1: StatsBomb 'Saved Off Target' is reported apart, with Blocked, because C4 defines on target as a save and off target as off target, post or wayward, and this outcome is a save of a shot going wide.

The open scan covers the levels of the categories with role 'category'. The post-shot categories, the 3 s rebound (a sensitivity check of item 2) and the half (the negative control) are not scanned. A two-level category scans one level, because the other is its mirror. 'Floors met in both halves' means the category floor on the whole primary population plus the scan floor in each half.
The combined population is the paper's: it also leaves out the one StatsBomb-only row of the pre-registered frame exclusion (decode-corrupted frame), so it has 3,401 shots, not 3,402.
Bootstrap p-values are shares of draws (no +1 correction), as the paper's superiority p.

Power simulation (C4: 'permute category labels across shots, preserving sizes; inject a 0.15-logit effect'): it holds the paper's frozen recalibration fixed instead of refitting it in every draw and half, which makes the intervals narrower. The shot-level permutation also breaks the match clustering of match-level categories (league-season, camera view) and their correlation with z_D. Both make the power optimistic, most of all for match-level levels. Labels for the log-loss items are drawn from the recalibrated vendor. Log-loss and correlation items plant their own thresholds (0.005 LL, 0.10), since a 0.15-logit gap has no log-loss or correlation unit; scenario '<id>:logit' also shifts F by 0.15 logit for the log-loss items. Item 8 has no category to permute and is simulated as 0 or 0.10 plus the real statistic's bootstrap deviations, so the simulation computes that statistic's spread, never its value.

categories.name: shot_type
categories.rule: StatsBomb shot type (penalties are out of every population)

categories.name: play_pattern
categories.rule: StatsBomb play pattern of the possession

categories.name: key_pass_cross
categories.rule: the key pass is a cross (pass.cross)

categories.name: key_pass_through
categories.rule: the key pass is a through ball

categories.name: key_pass_cutback
categories.rule: the key pass is a cut-back (pass.cut_back)

categories.name: key_pass_none
categories.rule: the shot has no key pass (kp_has == 0)

categories.name: key_pass_height
categories.rule: StatsBomb height of the key pass; undefined without a key pass

categories.name: distance
categories.source: sb_dist: StatsBomb pre-contact feature (xgpoc.vendor.comparator_features) `dist` (distance to the goal centre, yards)

categories.name: angle
categories.source: sb_angle: StatsBomb pre-contact feature (xgpoc.vendor.comparator_features) `angle` (goal-mouth angle, radians, binned in degrees)

categories.name: outside_box
categories.rule: outside the penalty area: x < 102 or |y - 40| > 22

categories.name: defenders_in_cone
categories.rule: outfield opponents in the shooter-post-post triangle: 0, 1, 2 or more

categories.name: gk_depth
categories.source: sb_gk_depth: StatsBomb pre-contact feature (xgpoc.vendor.comparator_features) `gk_depth` (120 - goalkeeper x, yards)
categories.rule: bins [0, 2), [2, 4), [4, inf), a goalkeeper behind the line counts as 0; undefined without a goalkeeper in the freeze frame

categories.name: gk_off_line
categories.source: sb_gk_off_line: StatsBomb pre-contact feature (xgpoc.vendor.comparator_features) `gk_off_line` (signed distance from the shooter-goal line)
categories.rule: bins of |gk_off_line| [0, 0.5), [0.5, 1.5), [1.5, inf); undefined without a goalkeeper

categories.name: nearest_opponent
categories.source: sb_ff_near_opp: StatsBomb pre-contact feature (xgpoc.vendor.comparator_features) `ff_near_opp` (nearest outfield opponent, yards)

categories.name: rebound_5s
categories.rule: the previous shot of the same match, period and possession is by the same team and 0-5 s earlier

categories.name: rebound_3s
categories.rule: as rebound_5s with 0-3 s (sensitivity check of item 2)

categories.name: rebound_subtype
categories.source: seq_prev_outcome: StatsBomb outcome of the previous shot
categories.rule: for a 5 s rebound: after_save (Saved, Saved to Post, Saved Off Target), after_block (Blocked), after_other; none otherwise (descriptive, not scanned)

categories.name: homography
categories.source: e3_homography_ok: detector descriptor at offset 0 (cache/xgd_full3/E3, offset_ms == 0)

categories.name: players_visible
categories.source: e3_n_players: detector descriptor at offset 0 (cache/xgd_full3/E3, offset_ms == 0)
categories.rule: terciles of the number of detected players: low <= players_low_max, high >= players_high_min (label-free cuts)

categories.name: keypoints_visible
categories.source: e3_n_keypoints: detector descriptor at offset 0 (cache/xgd_full3/E3, offset_ms == 0) (a zoom proxy)

categories.name: gk_visible
categories.source: e3_gk_detected: detector descriptor at offset 0 (cache/xgd_full3/E3, offset_ms == 0)

categories.name: ball_detected
categories.source: e3_ball_ok: detector descriptor at offset 0 (cache/xgd_full3/E3, offset_ms == 0)

categories.name: league_season
categories.rule: league and season of the match

categories.name: minute
categories.source: sb_minute, half: StatsBomb minute and period of the shot
categories.rule: first half 0-14, 15-29, 30 to the end; second half 45-59, 60-74, 75 to the end; extra time

categories.name: timing_residual_top
categories.source: timing_residual_ms: SoccerNet anchor minus aligned StatsBomb time

categories.name: half
categories.source: half: the period of the shot

categories.name: on_target_sn
categories.source: labels: on_target_sn (SoccerNet 'Shots on target', counts blocked shots)

categories.name: sb_outcome
categories.source: labels: sb_outcome (StatsBomb outcome of the shot)

parameters.scale: paper's frozen out-of-fold Platt recalibration, held fixed across draws and halves
